item.text: {"batch_id":"m6_smoke-proxy-009","reviewer_kind":"codex_ai_proxy_m6_method_smoke","rows":[{"assignment_id":"full_system:m2-011","method_id":"full_system","sample_id":"m2-011","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"节点 2 从奇数表示直接跳到偶数结论，缺少代入并给出整数倍形式的推导。","repair_action":"在节点 2 前插入：x+y=(2m+1)+(2n+1)=2(m+n+1)，且 m+n+1 为整数；随后保留结论。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":[]},{"assignment_id":"full_system:m2-018","method_id":"full_system","sample_id":"m2-018","predicted_verdict":"gap","first_error_node":"2","diagnosis":"“两边分别乘以 x 和 y”未能合法地直接推出结论；需要利用 x=y 进行代换，连接 x²、xy 与 y²。","repair_action":"替换相关推导为：由 x=y，等式两边同乘 x 得 x²=xy；又由 x=y，xy=y²；故 x²=y²。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":[]},{"assignment_id":"full_system:m2-034","method_id":"full_system","sample_id":"m2-034","predicted_verdict":"invalid","first_error_node":"1","diagnosis":"节点 1 错误：对负数 a，sqrt(a²)=|a|≠a。其后节点关于每个实数均等于其绝对值的断言也错误，且因依赖节点 1 而失效。","repair_action":"替换节点 1 为：a²≥0，|a|≥0，且 |a|²=a²，因此 sqrt(a²)=|a|；删除失效的节点 2。","repair_outcome":"unverified_patch_proposed","claimed_repair_success":false,"confidence":"high","method_limitations":[]}]}
